description: This file defines a Scheduler class responsible for managing task queues with priorities, using caching mechanisms and handling request processing logic. It includes enums for cache keys, data models for queue items, and methods for queue operations such as add, poll, peek, and save.

classes.name: SchedulerCacheKeys
classes.description: An enum class holding cache key identifiers for scheduler queue and default TTL.

classes.name: FlowItem
classes.description: A data model representing an item in the scheduler queue with priority, request ID, and model name.

classes.name: Scheduler
classes.description: Main class managing task queues with priority handling, caching, and request polling.

methods.name: __init__( self, polling_interval: Optional[float] = None, redis_cache: Optional[RedisCache] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes the Scheduler with optional polling interval and redis cache, sets up cache and default TTL.

methods.name: add_request(self, request: FlowItem)
methods.description: Adds a new request to the queue based on its priority.

methods.name: bool poll(self, id: str, model_name: str, health_deployments: list)
methods.description: Checks if a request can be processed based on queue position and deployment health; may remove request from queue.

methods.name: bool peek(self, id: str, model_name: str, health_deployments: list)
methods.description: Checks if a request is at the top of the queue without removing it.

methods.name: get_queue_status(self)
methods.description: Returns the current internal queue array, mainly for status inspection.

methods.name: list get_queue(self, model_name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the queue for a specific model name, using cache if available.

methods.name: None save_queue(self, queue: list, model_name: str)
methods.description: Saves the updated queue to cache for a specific model name.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.signature: ( self, polling_interval: Optional[float] = None, redis_cache: Optional[RedisCache] = None, )

ctags.name: get_queue
ctags.pattern: /^    async def get_queue(self, model_name: str) -> list:$/

ctags.name: peek
ctags.pattern: /^    async def peek(self, id: str, model_name: str, health_deployments: list) -> bool:$/
ctags.signature: (self, id: str, model_name: str, health_deployments: list)

ctags.name: poll
ctags.pattern: /^    async def poll(self, id: str, model_name: str, health_deployments: list) -> bool:$/
ctags.signature: (self, id: str, model_name: str, health_deployments: list)

ctags.name: save_queue
ctags.pattern: /^    async def save_queue(self, queue: list, model_name: str) -> None:$/
